description: ANDE’s generation page describes hydroelectric units, nominal ratings, available Paraguayan capacity and connections for Itaipú, Acaray and Yacyretá. It also lists several smaller thermal plants. The provider is Administración Nacional de Electricidad. Coverage: Coverage is Paraguay’s generation supply as represented on an undated technical page. The text retains a connection milestone expected in October 2014, so it cannot establish current infrastructure status. Access: The provider technical page was read through the web reader. No equipment data files were obtained. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: MW and MVA ratings and total plant capacity versus Paraguay’s share are distinct. The stale milestone prevents using the page as a current capacity inventory. For simulation it provides historical asset characteristics and pointers for further verification. Related resources: ANDE master plans are a separate forward-planning source and do not validate these undated figures.
